slug: 2024-03-15 Undersea cables for Africa's internet retrace history and leave digital gaps as they connect continents

facts.fact: The Conversation Africa (Jess Auerbach Jahajeeah) says southern Africa's internet comes largely through the landing stations at Melkbosstrand near Cape Town and Mtunzini in northern KwaZulu-Natal, both in South Africa; no cables are named.
